'''Almoren''' was one of the [[Ten Nations]] which was destroyed during the [[Trolloc Wars]].

==Geography==
[[Image:Almoren.png|thumb|left|200px|In red location within the Ten Nations]]

Almoren was located in the east of the [[Westlands]]. It stretched from north of [[Kinslayer's Dagger]] to [[Haddon Mirk]] and from the [[Erinin]] to the [[Spine of the World]]. It was bordered by [[Essenia]] to the south, [[Coremanda]] and [[Tar Valon]] to the west and [[Aramaelle]] to the north. Its capital city was [[Al'cair'rahienallen]] (which later became [[Cairhien]]) and its other major [[Ogier]]-built city was [[Jennshain]].{{ref|{{bwb}}, Ch10|Ch10}} 

Almoren's territory incorporated all of modern [[Cairhien]] and a substantial amount of additional land. {{ref||Ch10}}

==History==
Almoren was founded after the [[Breaking of the World]] and was brought into the [[Compact of the Ten Nations]] by King Coerid Nosar.{{ref||Ch10}} In {{ab|742}}, the nation was ruled by a queen, whose Right Hand, [[Jurith Dorine]], wrote ''Commentaries on the Prophecies of the Dragon''. {{ref/book|2|Prologue}}

Almoren was overrun and destroyed during the Trolloc Wars. Following the wars its territory was divided by the new kingdoms of [[Hamarea]], [[Ileande]], [[Tova]], [[Shandalle]] and [[Khodomar]]. {{ref||Ch10}}

Its name translated into the Common Tongue is possibly "For the People" - from the [[Old Tongue]] words ''al'' (meaning "for the" or "of the") and ''mora'' (meaning "people", pluralized as ''moren''{{ref|{{twotc}}, Old Tongue, Words and Phrases in the Old Tongue, Various Rules, Pluralization}}). {{ref|{{twotc}}, Old Tongue}}
